The QuestDB stack publishes 9009, and an ILP load through the adapter reaches the server.
The Firebolt Core limits under mocker and Apple container are documented, with the exact error.

Working command: `mocker run --platform linux/amd64 -m 4g -c 4 -p 13306:3306 -e ROOT_PASSWORD=benchbox ghcr.io/singlestore-labs/singlestoredb-dev:latest`. description:
Found during live verification on 2026-11-06 with mocker 0.7.2 on macOS (evidence on live-verify-perf-batches-evidence-20261106). (1) Doris: `mocker compose` ignored the stack's entrypoint and memory settings; the container got 1112 MB, the FE JVM died, and `up --wait` still reported OK. It worked with `mocker run -m 4g --entrypoint bash` and the repo's entrypoint script. (2) Firebolt Core: mocker ignores the memlock ulimit, so the server dies with `io_uring_register_buffers failed: Cannot allocate memory`. Under Apple `container` it needs more than 7 GiB for TPC-H SF0.01 and hung at 7 GiB. (3) QuestDB: docker/questdb compose does not publish ILP port 9009, so the ILP load path cannot reach the server (an engine-independent stack defect).

Change. Make tests/uat bring-up detect and fail loudly when the engine drops a declared entrypoint, memory limit or ulimit, instead of reporting healthy. Publish 9009 in docker/questdb. Document the per-engine limits in the UAT framework docs. Do not prune globally.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree; heavy work only through make heavy-run; no explanatory comments.
